messages.content: Now that Lenexa is done, can you look at Palm Springs for me and my wife? We want a low-effort winter weekend. Friday after work, Sunday back unless she can take Monday. Compare Palm Springs airport versus Ontario.
Sure. Which weekend, and is Friday departure after noon okay or truly after the workday? Any hotel area you want?
Weekend of Feb 21. We can leave after noon Friday. Hotel should be well-reviewed, downtown or Uptown, walkable to dinner, quieter room, and a good pool. This is not a work-hotel exercise.
Understood. I'll price two adults for Friday-Sunday and Friday-Monday. Any rough hotel ceiling? And are you thinking rental car for the whole stay or only if you do a hike?
Try to stay under $350 a night before taxes. We may do one desert hike. Otherwise I don't want to spend the weekend in a car.

Here's the quick airport tradeoff. PSP: nonstop Bay Area options Friday afternoon, about 1.5 hours in the air, airport is 10 minutes from downtown. Current round trip is roughly $330-$360 per person. ONT: more flight choices and about $190-$230 per person, but you need the car for the whole trip and the I-10 drive is 75-110 minutes each way before traffic. After rental cost, Ontario saves roughly $150-$250 total for two but adds three hours or more of driving. Best fit for low-effort is PSP; Ontario is the acceptable backup if the PSP fares jump.
Friday from Ontario sounds exactly like what I don't want. If Monday happens, is the PSP return better than Sunday?

Yes. Monday is easier. The Sunday PSP returns are either early or expensive; Monday has a 1:10 p.m. nonstop after checkout and a later 4:50 p.m. option if you want a pool morning. The extra cost is mainly the third hotel night.
Hotel shortlist?

Best fit: Andreas Hotel & Spa downtown, about 4.6 guest rating, refundable quiet king around $319 before taxes, courtyard pool, easy walk to Palm Canyon restaurants. Acceptable backup: Alcazar in Uptown, also strong reviews, a little cheaper and low-key, but farther north. More scene than quiet: ARRIVE Palm Springs; good pool and restaurants, but I would not pick it if sleep matters. Nice but over ceiling: Kimpton Rowan, rooftop pool and central location, closer to $390+.
Which combination would you hold if Monday clears?

PSP plus Andreas for Friday-Monday. It keeps the arrival simple, gives you a real pool setup, and avoids turning Friday and Monday into driving days. If Monday falls through, I'd recheck Andreas first, then Alcazar for the shorter stay.
Can you hold Andreas without booking flights? Monday won't be confirmed until Tuesday.

I can't lock it without making a refundable reservation, so I have not booked anything. I saved Andreas as the lead option and set a Tuesday recheck for the quiet king, PSP flights, and compact car. Ask before booking: whether Monday is approved, whether to rent the car all weekend or just rideshare plus one-day rental, and whether the PSP premium is still under about $250 versus Ontario.

Yes. Andreas Hotel & Spa is confirmed Friday through Monday in the refundable quiet king, with the away-from-elevator and away-from-ice-machine request added. Compact rental car is confirmed at PSP for pickup after arrival and return before the Monday flight.
Send me the timing so I can forward it at home.

Friday: depart SFO 3:15 p.m., land PSP 4:45, pick up the compact car, and expect to reach Andreas around 5:25-5:40. Monday: checkout around 11, return the car around 11:45, fly PSP-SFO 1:10-2:45. A 7:00 p.m. Friday dinner reservation is safe; the only open leisure pieces are which hike day and whether you want me to suggest dinner spots.
